title: angraecum ochraceum
intro: Angraecum ochraceum, commonly known as the orange orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the orchid family (Orchidaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Angraecum ochraceum include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antiviral, and antispasmodic activities.
